justification: The witnesses verify the same defects: y=(0,-1) is unbounded above on x_1<=1, contradicting the claimed maximum 0; and y=(1,1) satisfies the proposed row inequalities while x=(1,1) gives y^T x=2>1, disproving the polar formula. The assessment overstates failure of both containments on this single example, but its matching counterexamples are valid.
